_comment: Overlay on the general base for the 'technology' domain. Polarity is from a product/company view; "disruption" is neutral because it is praise for a startup and a complaint about an outage. 'positive'/'negative' entries re-file a term (removing it from the opposite list); 'neutral' drops a base term because its polarity is not stable here. STARTER lexicon, unvalidated against labelled data; extend before relying on it.
